title: Disable rule (this line, this unit, this project)
summary: Silence one lint rule for a line (dl:ok marker), a unit or the project (rule_overrides in drag-lint-lint.json), with a reason and date; rules enable undoes it
intro: Read this when a finding is right for most of the code but not here: disable the rule for this line, this unit or this project from the RAD Studio editor's right-click menu or with rules disable, and undo it with rules enable. Unit and project scope never write into the source.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint rules disable|enable --rule <id> --scope line|unit|project [--in <F> --line <N>] --reason "<text>" [--project <.dproj>] [--config <drag-lint-lint.json>] [--json]   (line = a dl:ok marker on the line; unit / project = rule_overrides in the project lint config, with reason and date; enable undoes one disable)
help: drag-lint rules disable|enable --rule <id> --scope line|unit|project [--in <F> --line <N>] --reason "<text>" [--project <.dproj>] [--config <drag-lint-lint.json>] [--json]   (line = a dl:ok marker on the line; unit / project = rule_overrides in the project lint config, with reason and date; enable undoes one disable)

steps: Put the caret on a line that shows a drag-lint finding
Choose drag-lint > Code Quality > Disable Rule...
Pick Disable here (this line), Disable in this unit or Disable in this project
Type a one-line reason and press OK

surfaces.caption: drag-lint > Disable Rule...
steps: Put the caret on a line that shows a drag-lint finding

questions.ask: Silence one rule on this line only, with a reason.
Silence one rule in one unit without touching the source.
Turn one rule off for the whole project.
